HOW IT WORKS
BUYSWhen 4 or more of its 7 timeframes agree on a support line and the price dips 0.8% below it.
SELLSWhen it falls under its higher-low line (at most 1.5% under the buy), when 4 of its 7 timeframes turn down, or it locks in a gain once up 0.69%. Everything is sold by 3:50 PM.
HOLDSMinutes to hours. Never overnight. One stock at a time, with all of its money.
NEXTTrades with 100% of its money until Fri Oct 30, then gives half to Momentum.

Tested 2024-26: about break-even; it lost money in 2024 and 2025.

03PKZ SCAN · GATE BY GATE 70 NAMES · SCANNED 12:10:09 ET · EVERY MINUTE · FRAMES 12:09 ET
HOW A NAME QUALIFIES FOR PKZ

1 · ZONE — on a timeframe that reads bullish (higher high and higher low), a line the price has touched 3 or more times.

2 · ALIGNED — 4 or more of the 7 frames (1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 1 hour, 4 hour, 1 day, 1 week) carry a live line touched 4+ times. The PKZ entry is the average of those lines.

3 · AT THE BUY PRICE — the live price trades 0.8% or more UNDER that entry, still above the lowest higher low and within 1.5% of the entry. The bot then places a limit buy at the entry minus 0.8%.

After the buy: it is sold the moment its price falls under its higher-low line, which is never more than 1.5% under the buy, or as soon as 4 or more of its 7 timeframes read bearish, whichever comes first. Once it is up 1% the stop locks +0.5%; once it is up the ARM RULE amount the stop keeps that much and trails 0.3% under its high. Every position is sold by 3:50 PM. One PKZ position at a time, using all of PKZ's free cash; a resting buy order counts as one.

WHAT THIS DOES TO YOUR TRADES

Nothing. Not one of these gates an entry. They are on screen as weather, not as a rule.

All twenty were walk-forwarded as entry gates on the fused rule (regime_test.py). The last column is the share of 2,000 bootstrap histories in which gating on that signal beat not gating — the bar is 90%.

1 of 20 cleared. Testing twenty candidates at a 10% false-positive rate throws up 2.0 winners by chance, so one winner is fewer than chance predicts. XLU/SPY at 92.5% is what a lottery ticket looks like, and after correcting for twenty tests the bar is ~99.5%. None was adopted.

The bot’s own edge sits in 2018, 2020 and 2022 — exactly when SPY is under its long average. A regime gate deletes its best years and re-enters late. A filter that helps a dip-buyer hurts a breakout bot.
